{{Quote|The largest corporate territory in the galaxy is the Corporate Sector, which includes over 30,000 habitable star systems, and is owned and governed by the Corporate Sector Authority.|[[2T-DS]]|<ref name="The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>}}
The '''Corporate Sector''' or '''"CorpSec"''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] that was governed by the independent [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. It was the largest corporate territory in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].

==Description==
[[File:Corporate_sector_EAOC.jpg|thumb|left|230px|The Corporate Sector and its surrounding [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]]]
The Corporate Sector was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], rimward to the [[Aparo sector/Legends|Aparo]] and [[Wyl sector/Legends|Wyl sectors]], at the end of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. The sector included thousands of inhabited systems along with more than one hundred thousand uninhabited systems.<ref name="TEA" />

The Sector was [[Humanocentrism|humanocentric]], especially during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]; it was rumored that many native [[species/Legends|species]] discovered there, were silently exterminated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
{{Quote|The Corporate Sector wasn't always what it is today. Back in the old days it was simply a place where businesses could go and make a few credits without too many bureaucrats getting into the act. As an enterprising businessman, I can appreciate that kind of setup. That was back when the Republic was something to be respected, and the businesses were kept on a tight leash. But things changed&hellip;|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Corporate Sector Sourcebook" />}}
The Corporate Sector was formed in [[490 BBY]]<ref name="TEGASx">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']], p. x</ref> to free the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] lawmakers and the Corporate moneymakers from their differences, after being exiled from the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] to the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]]. The Corporate Sector originally had a few hundred systems all devoid of intelligent life. Its creation came in the aftermath of the [[Outer Expansion Zone scandal|disastrous experiment]] with corporate control in the [[Outer Expansion Zone/Legends|Outer Expansion Zone]]. The new experiment was tried under more careful supervision; the Republic sent the equivalent of a full subsector's worth of ships to protect the rights of the workers in the sector and to ensure the companies preserved the basic integrity of the environment on the planets in the sector. The corporations allowed to operate in the sector could purchase entire regions of space, but were supervised by the Galactic Republic. A general tax was paid directly to the Republic government which enabled the companies to avoid the morass of sector, system, planetary, and local taxes found on most worlds in the Republic. The [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnans]] eventually became a key business partner in the Corporate Sector. During this time, the sector did well enough economically, but was too small and too remote to really thrive.<ref name="The New Jedi Order Sourcebook">''[[The New Jedi Order Sourcebook]]''</ref><ref name="TEA" /><ref name="Corporate Sector Sourcebook" />

As economic and political conditions within the Republic worsened (and as it fell under the sway of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]<ref name="TEA" />), most member companies joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] when the Clone Wars erupted. Loyalist companies were pushed out.<ref name="Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> In response, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], nationalized corporations and manufacturing, a decision welcomed almost unanimously by the galactic community.<ref name="TEA" />

At the close of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], half a dozen [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyers]] were sold to the Corporate Sector. The only other known ships of this class were part of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]], as well as one being part of a secret Jedi temple.

During [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor Palpatine's]] reign over the galaxy, the Corporate Sector expanded to nearly 30,000 star systems, and the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] was established to administrate the sector internally. Led by [[Orman Tagge/Legends|Orman Tagge]], the Sector became a vast experiment on nationalization. While the sector was self-governed and self-policed, the Empire did not bother with it, while receiving income from its profits. Corporations that invested in the Authority enjoyed proportional shares of the profits.<ref name="IHB" /><ref name="TEA" />

It was thus one of the few sectors the New Order allowed to continue relatively unabated from its time during the previous Republic era, as they tolerated corporate competition so long as several companies made sure they did things for the greater good of the Imperial citizenry. Han Solo and Chewbacca at some point got kicked out of the Corporate Sector due to "squeezing all the money out", which the former later recounted when discovering the Empire's role in the establishment of the Corporate Sector Authority via the ''Imperial Handbook''.<ref name="IHB">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>

After having captured the sectors surrounding the Corporate Sector in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Zsinj]] conquered the sector in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. The Corporate Sector stayed under Zsinj's control until [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|his death]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] and remained neutral during the [[Thrawn campaign]] of [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], following the [[Mission to Adumar]], parts of the Corporate Sector joined [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]], [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]], and [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] in fighting against the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. In [[44 ABY]], the Corporate Sector suffered a full [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] revolt, as it was happening everywhere else in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Omega Squad: Targets]]'' abbreviates Corporate Sector as "CorSec", which typically refers to the [[Corellian Security Force]]. "CorpSec" is the usual shortened form of Corporate Sector.
